ended_events.title: Philosophy for everyone: A Journey of Thought from Young to Old
ended_events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
ended_events.summary: The aim of this meeting is to present philosophy in a simple and accessible way for everyone, from children to adults, by highlighting its role in developing critical thinking and broadening one’s understanding of life. The meeting also seeks to bring philosophical concepts closer through an easy approach that helps make philosophy part of everyday dialogue and human thinking. Topics: The concept of philosophy and its importance in developing thinking skills for all ages. How philosophy helps both children and adults understand life and expand their ways of thinking.

ended_events.title: BAAB
ended_events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
ended_events.summary: After discovering cassette tapes hidden behind a green door, Wahida begins to unravel the truth about her twin sister's death. Plagued by tinnitus, her journey into the mountains uncovers a terrifying revelation. Nayla Al Khaja the UAE's first female director, is known for rich, moody visuals and layered storytelling. Her debut feature Three was the longest-running independent film in MENA, screening for 120 days in cinemas. With films on Netflix, her work blends psychological beauty and horror, tackling social taboos like grief, divorce and identity while presenting Arabic Gulf culture in a raw, unsanitized way.,The

ended_events.title: Low-Budget Films – Opportunity, Artistic Choice, or a Phase?
ended_events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
ended_events.summary: This panel sheds light on the experience of low-budget filmmaking as one of the production models adopted by filmmakers. Are these films an opportunity to assert a distinctive creative voice? A conscious artistic choice? Or merely a transitional phase in the careers of directors and producers on their way to larger-scale projects? The panel brings together filmmakers who have worked across productions of varying budget scales to share their perspectives on the challenges involved, the creative choices available, and the potential solutions that may support this mode of production and contribute to its sustainability.

ended_events.venue: Ithra - Ithra Tower - Level 5, Immersive Lab
ended_events.summary: Sound can be a powerful tool in narrative building, and compelling stories can be told using the everyday sounds found around us. ended_events.title: Designing Presence
ended_events.organizer: King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture / Ithra
ended_events.summary: This one-day session introduces participants to the core principles of immersive storytelling by engaging them in hands-on, creative exercises rooted in sensory design and emotional resonance. Participants will explore how non-linear narrative, mood and emotion can be conveyed through spatial design — without relying on characters or dialogue. This session empowers creatives to recognize and express their own artistic voice while learning how to shape experiences that evoke feeling through atmosphere, texture and metaphor.

Large-scale, site-specific installations by Saudi and international artists respond to AlUla’s unique landscape, history, and culture. A vibrant programme of tours and events invites deeper engagement, continuing to build AlUla’s legacy as a global destination for art in the landscape. Desert X can be enjoyed in a variety of ways, including on foot - self-guided, or as part of a public or private guided tour - or in the comfort of an open-top car.

ended_events.title: ورشة "فن التعامل مع كبار الشخصيات والمشاهير"
ended_events.summary: عنوان الورشة او اللقاء: فن التعامل مع كبار الشخصيات والمشاهير المحاور: - مفهوم الاتصال. - تعريف البرتوكول والاتيكيت والمراسم والتشريفات. - من هم كبار الشخصيات والمشاهير. - بروتوكولات التعامل مع كبار الشخصيات. - الاتيكيت والذوق العام. - نماذج من البروتوكولات. الأهداف: - فن الإلقاء والتقديم وأساليب وطرق العرض. - مفهوم لغة الجسد وأهميتها في التعامل مع الأخرين. - الاستراتيجيات الأساسية في مهارات الحوار الفال. - البروتوكولات عند التعامل مع كبار الشخصيات والمشاهير. - بروتوكولات مصافحة كبار الشخصيات. الفئة المستهدفة: قطاع السياحة والترفيه والضيافة و موظفي الاتصال المؤسسي في كافة القطاعات. الموعد والموقع: اليوم ( الاربعاء) التاريخ ( 14/7/2025م ) الموقع (المسرح -القاعة - الأكاديمية ) من الساعه( 10ص ) الى الساعه ( 12م ) مقدم الورشة: أ‌. أنور بن أحمد حكمي- رئيس اللجنة القطاعية للسياحة والترفيه بالغرفة ومدرب معتمد

ended_events.summary: Today, the Kingdom, represented by the Saudi Space Agency, participated in the G20 Space Economy Leaders’ Meeting held in Bangalore, India, on Thursday and Friday, July 6 and 7,2023, where His Excellency the CEO of the Saudi Space Agency, Dr. Muhammad bin Saud Al Tamimi, headed the Kingdom’s delegation.
